steps.name: Given the influencer actor is signed in for file uploads
And signed-url uploads are available to this actor
When the influencer requests a signed URL for file:
Then soft assert signed URL response status is 200
And soft assert response contains rateLimitInfo

signed-url response should contain rateLimitInfo; body: {"uploadUrl":"/api/dev-lite/upload/3a0fcff9-16e9-43bb-a081-0e275cf7165b","publicUrl":"/api/dev-lite/files/content/E2EINFLUENCER1792825200834/1792825201458_influencer-avatar.jpg","filePath":"content/E2EINFLUENCER1792825200834/1792825201458_influencer-avatar.jpg","expiresAt":"2026-10-24T07:05:01.45840

When the influencer uploads test image to signed URL
And the influencer confirms the upload
And the influencer sets their profilePicture to the uploaded public URL
Then soft assert profile update succeeds
